criteria.name: Default cli transport works and logs correctly
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:129-147 shows resolve_claude_transport() defaults to 'cli' with provenance 'default' when no env var or manifest setting exists. Line 376 logs 'verifier-transport: cli (provenance: default|manifest)' as required. The cli branch at lines 408-413 preserves the existing claude -p route unchanged.

criteria.name: SDK transport with subscription mode fails closed
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:361-366 implements fail-closed check: when claude_transport==sdk and auth_pairs doesn't contain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (subscription mode), it logs 'verifier-transport: fail-closed; verifier.claude.transport=sdk requires auth.claude.mode=api' and exits 1 before any process spawn.

criteria.name: SDK transport with api mode invokes verify-sdk.py via op-fetch
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:378-407 shows SDK branch: derives artefact_glob via derive_artefact_glob() at line 380, constructs sdk_out path at line 381, resolves advisor at line 382, and at lines 397-407 invokes 'op-fetch $auth_pairs -- python3 $sdk_script --stage-id $stage_id --card $card_path --artefact-glob $artefact_glob --out $sdk_out --model ...' with stdin redirected from /dev/null.

criteria.name: AUTOMETTA_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=cli env override works
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:134-136 shows env var check takes precedence over manifest. When AUTOMETTA_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=cli is set, transport='cli' and provenance='env'. Line 376 will log 'verifier-transport: cli (provenance: env)'.

criteria.name: Missing verify-sdk.py falls back to cli with warning
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:368-374 checks if sdk_script exists when transport is sdk. If missing, logs 'verifier-transport: warning; $sdk_script not found; falling back to cli', sets claude_transport='cli' and provenance='default', then proceeds to cli branch.

criteria.name: register-agent.sh called with same fields for both routes
criteria.evidence: scripts/spawn-verifier.sh:435-436 shows register-agent.sh called after both branches with identical arguments: repo_root, pid, 'verifier', family, verifier_identity, card_path, log_path, budget_secs, work_dir. The call is outside the transport-specific branches.
